name: Judgment Reliability Plan
description: Make the judgment pipeline crash-contained, durable, observable, and repairable so one bad SQLite job DB cannot crash the worker and operators can safely inspect, quarantine, drain, and recover jobs.

userStories.title: Add judgment job storage state and import health metadata
userStories.description: As a maintainer, I want `app.judgment_job` to persist storage state and import health fields so the worker and UI can reason about local job health without inferring everything from transient runtime state.
acceptanceCriteria: Add a DuckDB migration for `app.judgment_job.storage_state`, quarantine metadata fields, import metadata fields, and `pause_requested_at`.
Thread the new fields through judgment job query, mutation, and route payload types used by the server and client.
Existing jobs are backfilled to a non-null storage state that preserves current behavior until later preflight or drain logic updates them.

userStories.title: Compute per-job SQLite health snapshots
userStories.description: As a maintainer, I want a single place to compute live SQLite health for one judgment job so the worker, repair flows, and UI can all rely on the same storage-health view.
acceptanceCriteria: Add a health snapshot service that returns SQLite file bytes, WAL bytes, outbox row count, oldest unexported age, claimed outbox count, queue prompt counts, last ack seq, and retained row count for one job.
Jobs with missing or absent local SQLite DBs return safe null or zero health values instead of throwing.
The snapshot service uses explicit job IDs from `app.judgment_job` as the source of truth for active work instead of scanning the filesystem for background candidates.

userStories.title: Expose judgment job health via API
userStories.description: As an operator, I want summary and per-job health endpoints so the UI and repair tooling can query storage risk and recommended next actions without duplicating backend logic.
acceptanceCriteria: Add `GET /api/judgmentsjobs-health` with aggregate counts for healthy, draining, quarantined, retained-outbox, and stale-import jobs.
Add `GET /api/judgmentsjobs/:id/health` with storage state, import metadata, live SQLite counters, and a recommended next action.
Route tests cover healthy, missing, draining, and quarantined job health responses.

userStories.title: Create an isolated single-job SQLite importer
userStories.description: As a maintainer, I want SQLite outbox import to run as an isolated single-job command so native SQLite failures can be contained outside the main worker process.
acceptanceCriteria: Add a single-job import entrypoint that accepts `jobId` and `claimedBy` and runs one SQLite outbox import cycle for that job.

The entrypoint claims at most one outbox batch, validates foreign-key and duplicate constraints, appends judgments, queues mart refreshes, acknowledges the SQLite claim, and emits structured JSON output.
The entrypoint exits cleanly on success and returns a non-zero exit with structured failure output when the job import fails.

userStories.title: Use isolated importer in worker background import
userStories.description: As a maintainer, I want the worker to launch isolated per-job imports and quarantine only the failing job so one bad SQLite job DB cannot crash or block unrelated jobs.
acceptanceCriteria: Background import selects candidate jobs only from `app.judgment_job` in importable storage states instead of scanning every `.sqlite` file on disk.
The worker launches the isolated importer per job, records import start, success, failure, and exit code metadata, and continues processing other jobs when one job fails.
Jobs that repeatedly fail or crash the isolated importer are marked `quarantined` instead of retried forever.

userStories.title: Add isolated preflight and quarantine gates
userStories.description: As a maintainer, I want startup and resume to use an isolated preflight so unhealthy SQLite job DBs are quarantined before they can destabilize normal worker activity.
acceptanceCriteria: Add a lightweight isolated preflight that opens a job SQLite DB, verifies required tables and columns, runs small queue and outbox reads, and captures file and WAL sizes.
Worker startup runs preflight for eligible jobs and quarantines failed jobs without aborting the worker.
Starting or resuming a job runs the same preflight and blocks `quarantined` or failing jobs with actionable errors.

userStories.title: Make pause enter draining state and block unsafe resume
userStories.description: As an operator, I want pause to enter an explicit draining state and block unsafe resume so jobs cannot look safely paused while they still have unexported local state.
acceptanceCriteria: Pausing a job sets `pause_requested_at`, transitions `storageState` to `draining`, clears active queue state, and releases the SQLite lease.
Draining jobs are excluded from new prompt claims and LLM sends.
While a job is `draining` or `quarantined`, the API refuses resume or start with a clear operator-facing reason.

userStories.title: Finish drain cleanup and delete drained local jobs
userStories.description: As a maintainer, I want draining jobs to transition to drained only after export, acknowledgement, retention cleanup, and checkpointing finish so local SQLite state is deleted deterministically and safely.
acceptanceCriteria: Draining jobs transition to `drained` only after exportable outbox rows are imported, project refresh acknowledgement advances, retained rows are pruned, and WAL checkpoint completes.
Periodic cleanup checkpoints drained SQLite DBs and deletes drained job files deterministically when safe.
Tests cover draining-to-drained transition, retained-row gating, and deterministic file deletion.

userStories.title: Add targeted repair actions and CLI
userStories.description: As an operator, I want single-job repair actions in both API and CLI form so I can inspect, drain, checkpoint, quarantine, and recover one job without shell-only debugging or risky bulk actions.
acceptanceCriteria: Add single-job repair actions for preflight, drain, checkpoint, quarantine, unquarantine, and repair.
Provide both API endpoints and a matching CLI or script entrypoint for local and emergency repair.
Repair actions return structured results and never act on more than one job per invocation.

userStories.title: Show job health inline in the admin jobs list
userStories.description: As an operator, I want `/admin/jobs` to show job health inline so I can spot draining, quarantined, and risky jobs while using the normal jobs table.
acceptanceCriteria: Add a health summary strip above the `/admin/jobs` table with counts for draining, quarantined, retained outbox, and stale import jobs.
Add a `Health` column to the jobs table with concise badges such as `Healthy`, `Draining`, `Quarantined`, `Retained Outbox`, and `Large WAL`.
Non-healthy jobs link directly to the job detail or health view without making the main table hard to use for normal job management.
Browser verify `/admin/jobs`: health summary renders, non-healthy jobs are easy to spot, and links to details and health page work

userStories.title: Add a local storage health card and repair actions to job detail
userStories.description: As an operator, I want `/admin/jobs/$id` to show local storage health and repair controls so I can diagnose and recover one job without leaving its detail view.
acceptanceCriteria: Add a `Local Storage Health` card to `/admin/jobs/$id` showing storage state, SQLite size, WAL size, outbox metrics, last import success and failure, failure count, exit code, and quarantine reason.
Wire repair actions on the detail page to the targeted repair endpoints and refresh the displayed health after each action completes.
Resume controls on the page stay blocked with clear messaging while the job is `draining` or `quarantined`.
Browser verify `/admin/jobs/$id`: storage-health card shows live state, quarantine or drain actions update the UI correctly, and resume is blocked when it should be

userStories.title: Add a dedicated judgment job health page
userStories.description: As an operator, I want a focused `/admin/jobs/health` page so I can triage risky jobs first and use repair flows without overloading the normal jobs list.
acceptanceCriteria: Add `/admin/jobs/health` focused on reliability triage rather than normal job management.
The page sorts risky jobs first and supports filters for draining, quarantined, retained outbox, large WAL, and stale import jobs.
Only batch-safe actions are available from the health page, and individual jobs link back to full job details.
Browser verify `/admin/jobs/health`: filters work, risky jobs sort first, and repair actions produce visible state transitions

userStories.title: Add a system sqlite3 fallback for pathological repair cases
userStories.description: As a maintainer, I want explicit repair tooling to fall back to the system `sqlite3` CLI for one job so pathological Bun-native SQLite failures can still be diagnosed and recovered without risking the normal worker path.
acceptanceCriteria: Repair tooling can run system `sqlite3` diagnostics, checkpoint, or export steps for one job when Bun-native isolated import still cannot safely recover it.
The fallback is opt-in and limited to explicit repair flows, not the routine background importer.
Fallback results are captured in structured repair output so operators can see what ran and what changed.
